name: docker-compose-stack
description: Converge a docker compose project on the host running apply — `docker compose up -d` in a directory (idempotent), running-container count as output
instructions: Host-converging module: apply runs `docker compose up -d` in `dir` on the machine running apply (Docker + compose plugin required). The compose file itself is yours to manage — import a host-file instance for the stack's .env to sequence secret materialization before up.
